title: Treasury Clearing Days for Earnings on Universal Life Insurance Guideline Excess
content:
Earnings on guideline excess refunded from an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy start on a date that follows how the excess payment was made. The excess payment is the most recent premium payment in the activity history; its payment method and receipt date are shown on that entry.

## Clearing standard

| Payment method of the excess payment | Earnings start on |
|---|---|
| Check | The receipt date plus **5** days (the check clearing days) |
| Debit card or online bank payment | The receipt date plus **1** day (the card clearing days) |
| Any other way (for example EFT, a conversion credit or an exchange) | The receipt date |

## Hypothetical readings (receipt date 10 March)

| Payment method | Earnings start | Days lost to clearing |
|---|---|---|
| Check | 15 March | 5 |
| Debit card | 11 March | 1 |
| Online bank payment | 11 March | 1 |
| EFT | 10 March | 0 |

With earnings running to 9 May, a check payment received on 10 March earns for 55 days (15 March to 9 May) and an EFT payment for 60 days.
